text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Morniiing, Trainer-saaan. Mmm~~, feels so 
good nya~♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I was able to sleep shockingly well last 
night~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. I washed my cat plushie, and it 
turned out so fluffy."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I buried my face in its fluffy tummy, and 
it just drifted peacefully off to sleep.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And then in my dream, I got to sleep right 
next to a real kitty~.
choice_data_list: I even fell asleep inside the dream...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So with that, Sei-chan is full of energy 
today thanks to cat power~♪
